name: Wistia
desc: Video hosting and analytics for business. Manage your projects and media library.

actions.name: create_project
actions.description: Create a new project in your Wistia account.

actions.name: update_project
actions.description: Update the attributes of an existing project.

actions.name: get_media
actions.description: Retrieve the details of a single video or media file.

actions.name: find_media
actions.description: Search and list media in your account, optionally filtered by project, name, or type.

actions.name: update_media
actions.description: Update the name or description of a video or media file.

actions.name: copy_media
actions.description: Create a copy of a video or media file, optionally into a different project.

actions.name: delete_media
actions.description: Permanently delete a video or media file from your account.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_media
triggers.description: Triggers when a new video or media file is added to your account.

triggers.name: new_project
triggers.description: Triggers when a new project is created in your account.
